SyncMe Release 1.4.3
======================
This folder contains both customer packages:

1) SyncMe-Setup-1.4.3.zip
   Backup PC console (wizard, backups, restore, schedule, HTTPS updates).
   Unzip, then run SyncMe-Setup.cmd (admin recommended on Windows Server).

2) SyncMe-Monitor-Setup-1.4.3.zip  (optional add-on)
   Self-hosted fleet dashboard for LAN / Tailscale.
   Unzip to a Monitor PC, edit Config\Monitor.json token, run SyncMe-Monitor.bat.
   On each Backup PC: Operations -> Fleet dashboards -> Monitor fields -> Save (sends a test ping).
   Optional: enable LocalOps Console registration on the same PC (loopback :8787).

Update feed (website): upload dist\updates\latest.json, SyncMe-Setup-1.4.3.zip, and SyncMe-Monitor-Setup-1.4.3.zip
to https://www.syncme.co.za/updates/ (site Downloads section uses the same folder).

SHA256 (SyncMe-Setup-1.4.3.zip): 5e1b2976f1653775e1bd67550af5655df0b1336880886dc169b7bdb15c32facd
